title: Tekken! Yurutto Cartoon

alternative_titles.ja: てっけん！ゆるっとカートゥーン

synopsis:
The globally acclaimed 3D fighting game series "TEKKEN" is getting an unexpected cartoon adaptation!

Stepping away from the usual serious battles, this short anime series depicts the daily lives of the Mishima family and fighters from around the world. 

Set in a laid-back and pop-style world that’s sure to bring a smile to your face, the series will showcase the "unexpected sides" of the TEKKEN characters.

(Source: Bandai Namco Entertainment)
